# mizorewww/bunny.yazi 🐰

*🩷 Hop around your filesystem 🩷*

A fork of [stelcodes/bunny.yazi](https://github.com/stelcodes/bunny.yazi) — a bookmark menu
for [Yazi](https://github.com/sxyazi/yazi) — with a **floating modal menu**, **nerd font
icons** and a couple of quality-of-life fixes.

## What's different from upstream

- **Floating menu** — the menu is a `Modal` window (like the official `mount.yazi`
  plugin): centered, floating over a fully visible Yazi interface.
- **Height capped at 50% of the screen**, single-column list that auto-scrolls when
  there are more hops than fit.
- **Nerd font icons** for every hop (special icons for the built-in actions).
- **Actual path column** — each row shows `<key> <icon> <desc>` plus the real path
  (`~/`-shortened) in a second column.
- **Instant hop keys** — press a hop's key and you're there; `j`/`k` or arrow keys move
  the cursor, `Enter` activates the highlighted row, `Esc`/`q` closes the menu,
  `Space` opens the fuzzy search.
- Fixes `some()` option-default handling (unset options used to receive `nil`) and a
  deadlock when re-indexing the `ui` composer from async plugin jobs.

> Press the menu keys one key at a time: the `ya.which` round-trip can drop keys that
> arrive in a burst (same as the official mount.yazi plugin). Hop keys are unaffected
> in practice — one press, one hop.

## Installation

### With `ya pkg` (recommended)

```sh
ya pkg add mizorewww/bunny
```

> Upgrading from upstream? Run `ya pkg delete stelcodes/bunny --discard` first.

### With `git`

```sh
git clone https://github.com/mizorewww/bunny.yazi ~/.config/yazi/plugins/bunny.yazi
```

### With Nix (Home Manager + flakes)

```nix
inputs = {
  bunny-yazi = {
    url = "github:mizorewww/bunny.yazi";
    flake = false;
  };
};
```

```nix
programs.yazi = {
  plugins.bunny = "${inputs.bunny-yazi}";
  initLua = ''
    require("bunny"):setup({ ... })
  '';
  keymap.mgr.prepend_keymap = [
    { on = "b"; run = "plugin bunny"; desc = "Start bunny.yazi"; }
  ];
};
```

Requires Yazi **26.5+** (the `Modal` component API).

## Configuration

`~/.config/yazi/init.lua`:

```lua
require("bunny"):setup({
	hops = {
		{ key = "/", path = "/",                desc = "Root" },
		{ key = "t", path = "/tmp",             desc = "Tmp" },
		{ key = "~", path = "~",                desc = "Home" },
		{ key = "c", path = "~/.config",        desc = "Config files" },
		{ key = "d", path = "~/Downloads",      desc = "Downloads" },
		{ key = "e", path = "~/Developer",      desc = "Dev projects" },
	},
	desc_strategy = "path",
	ephemeral = true, -- Enable ephemeral hops, default is true
	tabs = true,      -- Enable tab hops, default is true
	notify = false,   -- Notify after hopping, default is false
	fuzzy_cmd = "fzf", -- Fuzzy searching command, default is "fzf"
})
```

`~/.config/yazi/keymap.toml`:

```toml
[[mgr.prepend_keymap]]
desc = "Start bunny.yazi"
on = "b"
run = "plugin bunny"

# Optionally, jump straight into the fuzzy search
[[mgr.prepend_keymap]]
desc = "Start bunny.yazi fuzzy search"
on = "'"
run = "plugin bunny fuzzy"
```

> Upstream binds the menu to `;` — that would shadow Yazi's default
> `shell --interactive`, so this fork suggests `b` instead. Any free key works.

## Keys inside the menu

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| hop key (e.g. `d`) | Hop immediately, menu closes |
| `j` / `k` / `<Down>` / `<Up>` | Move the cursor |
| `Enter` | Activate the highlighted row |
| `Space` | Fuzzy search (fzf) |
| `<Backspace>` | Hop to the previous directory |
| `<Esc>` / `q` | Close the menu |

## Inspiration

[yamb.yazi](https://github.com/h-hg/yamb.yazi)

[nnn bookmarks](https://github.com/jarun/nnn/wiki/Basic-use-cases#add-bookmarks)

[[mgr.prepend_keymap]]
desc = "Start bunny.yazi"
on = ";"
run = "plugin bunny"

[[mgr.prepend_keymap]]
desc = "Start bunny.yazi fuzzy search"
on = "'"
run = "plugin bunny fuzzy"

#!/bin/bash
#/* vim: set filetype=bash : */

env "YAZI_CONFIG_HOME=$(pwd)" "YAZI_LOG=debug" yazi "$@"

bat ~/.local/state/yazi/yazi.log || cat ~/.local/state/yazi/yazi.log

require("bunny"):setup({
  hops = {
    -- { key = "r", path = "/", },
    -- { key = "u", path = "/usr", },
    -- { key = "o", path = "/opt", },
    -- { key = "T", path = "/tmp", },
    -- { key = "~", path = "/tmp", },
    -- { key = "😄", path = "/tmp", },
    -- { key = { "😄", "h" }, path = "/tmp", },
    -- { key = { "f", "h" }, path = "/tmp", },
    -- { key = { "\\" }, path = "/tmp", },
    -- { key = { "1" }, path = "/tmp", },
    -- { key = "`", path = "/tmp" },
    -- { key = "!", path = "/tmp", },
    -- { key = "@", path = "/tmp" },
    -- { key = "#", path = "/tmp" },
    -- { key = "$", path = "/tmp" },
    -- { key = "%", path = "/tmp" },
    -- { key = "^", path = "/tmp" },
    -- { key = "&", path = "/tmp" },
    -- { key = "*", path = "/tmp" },
    -- { key = "(", path = "/tmp" },
    -- { key = ")", path = "/tmp" },
    -- { key = "-", path = "/tmp" },
    -- { key = "_", path = "/tmp" },
    -- { key = "=", path = "/tmp" },
    -- { key = "+", path = "/tmp" },
    -- { key = "[", path = "/tmp" },
    -- { key = "{", path = "/tmp" },
    -- { key = "]", path = "/tmp" },
    -- { key = "}", path = "/tmp" },
    -- { key = "|", path = "/tmp" },
    -- { key = ";", path = "/tmp" },
    -- { key = ":", path = "/tmp" },
    -- { key = "'", path = "/tmp" },
    -- { key = "\"", path = "/tmp" },
    -- { key = ",", path = "/tmp" },
    -- { key = "<", path = "/tmp" },
    -- { key = ".", path = "/tmp" },
    -- { key = ">", path = "/tmp" },
    -- { key = "/", path = "/tmp" },
    -- { key = "?", path = "/tmp" },
    -- { key = "ñ", path = "/tmp" },
    { key = { "h", "h" }, path = "~", desc = "Home" },
    { key = { "h", "m" }, path = "~/Music", desc = "Music" },
    { key = { "h", "d" }, path = "~/Documents", desc = "Documents" },
    { key = { "h", "k" }, path = "~/Desktop", desc = "Desktop" },
    { key = { "n", "c" }, path = "~/.config/nix", desc = "Nix config" },
    { key = { "n", "s" }, path = "/nix/store", desc = "Nix store" },
    { key = "c", path = "~/.config", desc = "Config files" },
    { key = { "l", "s" }, path = "~/.local/share", desc = "Local share" },
    { key = { "l", "b" }, path = "~/.local/bin", desc = "Local bin" },
    { key = { "l", "t" }, path = "~/.local/state", desc = "Local state" },
  },
  -- desc_strategy = "filename",
  tabs = true,
  ephemeral = false,
  notify = true, -- notify after hopping, default is false
  fuzzy_cmd = "fzf",
})

Header:children_add(function(self)
  return "TESTING "
end, 1000, Header.RIGHT)

# git-cliff ~ default configuration file
# https://git-cliff.org/docs/configuration
#
# Lines starting with "#" are comments.
# Configuration options are organized into tables and keys.
# See documentation for more information on available options.

[changelog]
# template for the changelog header
header = """
# Changelog\n
All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.\n
"""
# template for the changelog body
# https://keats.github.io/tera/docs/#introduction
body = """
{% if version %}\
    ## [{{ version | trim_start_matches(pat="v") }}] - {{ timestamp | date(format="%Y-%m-%d") }}
{% else %}\
    ## [unreleased]
{% endif %}\
{% for group, commits in commits | group_by(attribute="group") %}
    ### {{ group | striptags | trim | upper_first }}
    {% for commit in commits %}
        - {% if commit.scope %}*({{ commit.scope }})* {% endif %}\
            {% if commit.breaking %}[**breaking**] {% endif %}\
            {{ commit.message | upper_first }}\
    {% endfor %}
{% endfor %}\n
"""
# template for the changelog footer
footer = """
<!-- generated by git-cliff -->
"""
# remove the leading and trailing s
trim = true
# postprocessors
postprocessors = [
  # { pattern = '<REPO>', replace = "https://github.com/orhun/git-cliff" }, # replace repository URL
]
# render body even when there are no releases to process
# render_always = true
# output file path
# output = "test.md"

[git]
# parse the commits based on https://www.conventionalcommits.org
conventional_commits = true
# filter out the commits that are not conventional
filter_unconventional = true
# process each line of a commit as an individual commit
split_commits = false
# regex for preprocessing the commit messages
commit_preprocessors = [
  # Replace issue numbers
  #{ pattern = '\((\w+\s)?#([0-9]+)\)', replace = "([#${2}](<REPO>/issues/${2}))"},
  # Check spelling of the commit with https://github.com/crate-ci/typos
  # If the spelling is incorrect, it will be automatically fixed.
  #{ pattern = '.*', replace_command = 'typos --write-changes -' },
]
# regex for parsing and grouping commits
commit_parsers = [
  { message = "^feat", group = "<!-- 0 -->🚀 Features" },
  { message = "^fix", group = "<!-- 1 -->🐛 Bug Fixes" },
  { message = "^doc", group = "<!-- 3 -->📚 Documentation" },
  { message = "^perf", group = "<!-- 4 -->⚡ Performance" },
  { message = "^refactor", group = "<!-- 2 -->🚜 Refactor" },
  { message = "^style", group = "<!-- 5 -->🎨 Styling" },
  { message = "^test", group = "<!-- 6 -->🧪 Testing" },
  { message = "^chore\\(release\\): prepare for", skip = true },
  { message = "^chore\\(deps.*\\)", skip = true },
  { message = "^chore\\(pr\\)", skip = true },
  { message = "^chore\\(pull\\)", skip = true },
  { message = "^chore|^ci", group = "<!-- 7 -->⚙️ Miscellaneous Tasks" },
  { body = ".*security", group = "<!-- 8 -->🛡️ Security" },
  { message = "^revert", group = "<!-- 9 -->◀️ Revert" },
  { message = ".*", group = "<!-- 10 -->💼 Other" },
]
# filter out the commits that are not matched by commit parsers
filter_commits = false
# sort the tags topologically
topo_order = false
# sort the commits inside sections by oldest/newest order
sort_commits = "oldest"
